name: PM - Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Provides subsidies for installation of rooftop solar panels on residential houses, enabling households to generate their own electricity and reduce power bills.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹78,000 for rooftop solar installation; free electricity up to 300 units per month.

name: PM-KISAN: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme for small and marginal farmer families, providing financial benefit to supplement their needs for procuring inputs for agriculture.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each directly to bank accounts.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Financial inclusion program to ensure access to financial services such as banking, savings, deposit accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension.
benefits: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card; accident insurance of ₹2 lakh; life insurance of ₹30,000.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Housing scheme for the rural poor providing financial assistance for construction of pucca house with basic amenities to all homeless and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas for house construction.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed pension scheme targeted at the unorganised sector, providing a fixed pension from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after 60 years of age based on the contribution.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60; government co-contribution for eligible subscribers.

name: PM Vidyalakshmi: Education Loan Scheme
description: A portal for students seeking educational loans, connecting them with banks and financial institutions. It provides a single-window platform for student loan applications.
benefits: Access to education loans from multiple banks through single application; interest subsidy for economically weaker sections.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: A one-stop platform for various scholarship schemes offered by Central and State governments, enabling students to apply for and receive scholarships digitally.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Access to pre-matric, post-matric, and merit-based scholarships from central and state governments.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
description: Free food grains distribution scheme for the poor to ensure no one goes hungry. It provides wheat and rice to priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana families.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
benefits: 5 kg free food grains per person per month to eligible beneficiaries under NFSA.

name: Tamil Nadu Marriage Assistance Scheme
description: Financial assistance for the marriage of daughters of poor families in Tamil Nadu, providing monetary support to help meet marriage expenses.
ministry: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment
benefits: ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 financial assistance for marriage of daughters from economically weaker families.

name: Uttarakhand Vatsalya Yojana
description: Welfare scheme for children who lost their parents due to COVID-19 or other causes, providing financial support, education, and healthcare benefits in Uttarakhand.
ministry: Department of Women Empowerment & Child Development
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000 per orphan child; free education and healthcare support.

name: Madhya Pradesh Ladli Laxmi Yojana
description: A scheme for the welfare of girl children in Madhya Pradesh, providing financial support from birth through education to marriage, aimed at changing social attitudes towards girls.
benefits: Total financial assistance of ₹1,43,000 from birth to marriage; additional incentives for higher education.

name: Mizoram Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Pension scheme for senior citizens in Mizoram who are 60 years and above, providing monthly financial assistance to support their livelihood.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 to ₹500 for senior citizens aged 60 and above.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Provides micro-finance loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises through three categories: Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun.
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh).

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A small savings scheme for the girl child, encouraging parents to build a fund for future education and marriage expenses of their girl children with tax benefits.
benefits: Interest rate of 8.2% per annum (FY 2024-25); tax deduction under Section 80C; maturity after 21 years from account opening.

name: Tamil Nadu Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam
description: Crop insurance and agricultural support scheme for farmers in Tamil Nadu, providing compensation for crop loss due to natural calamities.
benefits: Crop insurance coverage; compensation for crop loss due to drought, flood, and other natural disasters.

name: PM-KUSUM: Solar Energy for Farmers
description: Provides subsidized solar pumps and supports solarization of agricultural pumps, enabling farmers to generate solar energy for irrigation and earn additional income by selling surplus power.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: 60% subsidy on solar pump installation; additional income from selling surplus solar power to the grid.
